engines.//: Pin the runtime to Node 25 (ABI 141 / NODE_MODULE_VERSION 141). The fleet runs linuxbrew node 25; native addons (better-sqlite3) built under any other major (e.g. nvm 22 = ABI 127) fail to load at runtime ('Module did not self-register'). See infra-fail-fast-build-integrity-2026-06-19 P-003 + .nvmrc. Advisory (no engine-strict) — declares the pin for nvm/CI/contributors; the deploy-gate native-addon preflight is the hard ABI enforcer.
